messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — sprint Signal Maplet: kernel perf + KV warmup. Goal: reduce p99 token latency by ~15% on short sequences by EOW. Owners: Maya (kernel), Samir (KV warmup), Lena (infra)
Maya Patel: TL;DR: kernel micro-optimizations + aggressive prefix caching. Need infra canary and a short perf harness.
Samir Kaur: On it. Started a KV warmup experiment on a small canary run; preliminary shows ~6% p99 improvement with early-prefetch.
Samir Kaur: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482 — includes prefetch flag and simple harness.
Lena Ortiz: Infra note: canary needs a dedicated node pool with GPU affinity and taints. Blocked on cloud quota at the moment. @Dave Chen can you help with quota or a temp pool?
Dave Chen: Yup — freeing up two g4 nodes tonight. Also filing a quota request now (GCP). Shouldn't block the overnight canary.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Samir, please add a tiny perf test to the PR — something that calls the generation path 50x with short seqs so we can capture p50/p95/p99. Example snippet for the harness:```python
def ablate_kv_warmup(client):
    for _ in range(50):
        r = client.generate("hello world\n")
    return client.metrics().p99\```
Samir Kaur: I will add that and a Jenkins job trigger. Also adding a `--kv-warmup` feature flag so we can toggle.
perf-bot: build #482 started (canary, tags: kv-warmup, continuous-batching)
Maya Patel: Heads-up — kernel patch A (microkernel kv-handshake) might require a handshake compatibility layer. If it lands first, we need a fallback. Suggest a feature flag `--kv-handshake-v2` and auto-fallback to v1 on errors.
Lena Ortiz: Good call. I'll draft a short rollout plan in Console: canary=5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated rollback on p99+ transient spikes.
Dave Chen: Quota approved. Canary pool ready: gcp-us-central1/g4-2 (user: infra-canary).
Samir Kaur: Will run the canary tonight after tests pass and post numbers here. If kernel patch is still open, I'll coordinate CR order.
Maya Patel: Great. If anyone sees regressions, ping this thread and @paging/eng-runtime. Otherwise, aim to merge small wins early. :thumbsup:
